en.answer: Since a <<7734>> Special Summoned by <<8609>> is not considered properly Synchro Summoned, it cannot be targeted by the effect of <<11944>>.
en.question: Can the effect of <<11944>> be used to Special Summon a <<7734>> that was banished after being Special Summoned by <<8609>>?
en.title: Can the effect of <<11944>> be used to Special Summon a <<7734>> that was banished after being Special Summoned by <<8609>>?

ja.answer: 「<<8609>>」の効果で特殊召喚されている「<<7734>>」は正規の手順によって特殊召喚されていませんので、「<<11944>>」の効果で特殊召喚する対象とする事はできません。
